ranking: ascending lowercase hexadecimal selection_key; task_id is the deterministic tie-breaker

reference_requirements: at least one edge-triggered sequential block
no initial block, delay control, system task, or Xilinx primitive
official reference passes its official testbench under the frozen Icarus preflight
testbench_requirements: random stimulus is permitted only when two fresh frozen-simulator processes produce byte-identical transcripts
contamination_requirements: no exact task-name collision in the declared local fine-tuning sources
no exact or normalized prompt match

outcome_independence: Eligibility uses only frozen upstream descriptions, references, testbenches, declared local training inputs, and reference-oracle self-tests. It never reads generated candidates, Vivado reports, timing, power, area, or policy identity.
